page_title: CAG 0-1 NAP | Cagliari v Napoli 20/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' The referee is firm and issues Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) a deserved yellow card.
90+3' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Marco Palestra (Cagliari).
85' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
84' Fabio Pisacane prepares a substitution. Juan Rodriguez is replaced by Othniel Raterink (Cagliari).
84' A substitution has been made. Sebastiano Esposito goes off and Yael Trepy (Cagliari) comes on.
84' Substitution. Juan Jesus (Napoli) on for Mathias Olivera.
79' Maurizio Mariani couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) and blew his whistle.
77' Antonio Conte has decided to substitute Billy Gilmour and he is replaced by Frank Anguissa (Napoli).
77' Substitution. Matteo Politano makes way for Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli).
76' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) produces a header from inside the penalty area, but he doesn't manage to hit the ball properly and it flies well over the crossbar.
75' Paul Mendy (Cagliari) leans back and sends a volley well wide of the left post from inside the box. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
73' The game has come to an end for Jose Pedro. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Paul Mendy (Cagliari).
73' Fabio Pisacane has decided to make a change. Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) replaces Michel Adopo.
72' Neat passing move from Napoli in order to create new attacking opportunities.
69' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
69' Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) commits a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for an infringement.
66' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) will take the corner.
66' A cross into the box from Michel Adopo (Cagliari) is cleared.
65' Substitution. Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Michael Folorunsho walks off.

62' Scott McTominay (Napoli) meets a cross from Kevin De Bruyne, but he cannot keep his header on target. It goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
61' Dangerous play by Yerry Mina (Cagliari). Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.
60' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
58' A poor attempt from the edge of the box. Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) dragged a first-time shot well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
58' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.

57' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Matteo Politano (Napoli) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Elia Caprile pulls off a comfortable save.
55' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle. Sam Beukema (Napoli) commits a foul after dangerous play.
55' It will be a substitution. Alisson Santos (Napoli) is ready to enter the pitch as Stanislav Lobotka walks off.
54' Matteo Politano (Napoli) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.

53' Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.
52' A pass by Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
51' Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
48' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) commits a foul and Maurizio Mariani immediately signals a free kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Kevin De Bruyne (Napoli) took the corner.
44' Miguel Gutierrez (Napoli) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Napoli have a corner.
42' Matteo Politano (Napoli) swings in a cross from the corner, but Elia Caprile reads it well and gathers the ball.

42' Scott McTominay (Napoli) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Napoli will take a corner kick.
41' Matteo Politano (Napoli) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
40' Great teamplay by Napoli as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
37' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
35' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot at goal. His effort is blocked by Vanja Milinkovic-Savic with a brilliant diving save!
35' Maurizio Mariani shows a yellow card to Jose Pedro (Cagliari) for his blatant foul.
34' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) is penalised for holding. Maurizio Mariani signals a set piece.
33' The referee blows his whistle after Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
30' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
29' 0:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
28' Maurizio Mariani has a clear sight and sees a foul from Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli).
24' Napoli enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

23' Matteo Politano (Napoli) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Elia Caprile!

20' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) makes a good run with the ball into the box, but mishits his shot as it goes way wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.
19' The game is interrupted. Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
18' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) is able to continue to play.
17' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
17' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) was quite harsh and Maurizio Mariani didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
16' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Napoli was in an offside position.
16' Napoli quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

16' Scott McTominay (Napoli) makes a good late run into the box and times his jump perfectly to get on the end of the corner kick, but his close-range header is brilliant blocked to deny him a certain goal. The referee signals a corner kick to Napoli.
15' Matteo Politano (Napoli) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
15' Rasmus Hojlund (Napoli) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
14' Scott McTominay (Napoli) makes a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul.

12' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
10' The ball possession is 22:78.
6' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but his effort is straight at Elia Caprile.
5' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Napoli will take a free kick.
4' Napoli control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
3' Referee Maurizio Mariani points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Scott McTominay (Napoli) goes wild in celebration.
3' The Napoli players halt their celebrations as referee Maurizio Mariani makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
2' 0 - 1 Goal 0:1! Scott McTominay (Napoli) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
2' Matteo Politano (Napoli) prepares to take a corner kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Napoli will take the kick-off.
Maurizio Mariani is introduced as the referee for today's match.
